detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Mindjot LSCity Forum

Written by anonymous

Posted Sept. 4th, 2028 at 4:12am

“We, the citizens of Los Sueños, are stuck in a living nightmare. I’d say we need to open our eyes, but the gunshots that echo through our streets year over year make it impossible to even sleep.

CONSTANT mass shootings, bombings, robberies, roving gangs, cartels, human trafficking, terror attacks.

Is SWAT going to show up?

Maybe.

How many more times?

What is being done to actually prevent this? Last night our one charity event to address this crisis was a terror target, now all we have from it are photos of massacre, putrid skin bubbling on victims and survivors.

We try to deal with droughts that kill our ability to feed our communities. Drugs that devastate our families. Collapsing banking systems. Criminal organizations who fester on the corruption. The federal government can barely even help us.

It almost seems like they want us to fall apart

We tried. We gave the LSPD and this whole s**tshow a shot. What are we doing as the blood of every innocent person who dies on our streets boils in the cracks?

NOW WE MUST TAKE TO THE STREETS, TO THE BANKS, TO THOSE IN THEIR IVORY TOWERS, TO THE FAILED JUSTICE SYSTEMS THAT LEAVE US TO SUFFER”

Features:

Three new missions:

• ‘No Good Deed’

• ‘All Gods Burn’

• ‘A New America’

Note: Multiplayer lobby hosts owning the DLC can host these missions for non-DLC owners.

DLC Exclusive Cosmetics

•Head

- ADV Headset (multiple colorways)

- Tactical Beanie (variant w/ Headset, multiple colorways)

- Tactical Cap (Forward and Backward Variants, w/ 2x Comms Headset options and multiple colorways)

- Bone Conduction Tactical Headset

- Single-Ear Radio Headset (Black and OD Green)

- Tactical Rebreather Gasmask

• Torso

- ‘Artemis’ Heavy Tactical Vest Cosmetic Variant (multiple colorways)

- Machinex Fingerless Gloves

- 4 DLC Exclusive Tattoos

• Legs

- LV Jeans

• Footwear

- Chameleon Boots

• Cosmetics available upon fully completing Boiling Point missions:

- 2 more Tattoos

- 2 more Cosmetic Items

Disclaimer: Base game required to play Boiling Point DLC. Be careful to avoid duplicate purchases.
